stops.name: Garajonay National Park
stops.detail: Garajonay National Park (Spanish: Parque nacional de Garajonay, pronounced [ˈpaɾke naθjoˈnal de ɣaɾaxoˈnaj]) is located in the center and north of the island of La Gomera, one of the Canary Islands (Spain).  It was declared a national park in 1981 and a World Heritage Site by UNESCO in 1986.  It occupies 40 km2 (15 sq mi) and it extends into each of the six municipalities on the island.
